questions_and_answers.question_text: In German, the preposition 'an' can refer to a location or destination where?

answers.answer: On or by a body of water

questions_and_answers.question_text: Which example uses 'an' to indicate destination by a body of water?

answers.answer: Ich freue mich schon auf die Alpen

questions_and_answers.question_text: 'Letzten Sommer waren wir an der Ostsee' means:

answers.answer: Last summer we were at the Baltic Sea
Last summer we were in the mountains
Last summer we were at the city hall
Last summer we were in the forest

questions_and_answers.question_text: The preposition 'an' is also used to indicate the addressee or destination of what?
In 'Schreiben Sie an die Botschaft', what does 'an' convey?
Which example shows 'an' used with a particular adjective, verb or noun form?

answers.answer: Meine Frau kann sich nicht an das Klima gewöhnen
Ich freue mich schon auf die Alpen

questions_and_answers.question_text: In 'An dem Projekt waren zahlreiche ausländische Architekten beteiligt', what does 'an' mean?
'Sie erwähnten Ihr Interesse an der Geschichte der Insel' uses 'an' to express:

answers.answer: Interest in the history of the island

questions_and_answers.question_text: True or False: The preposition 'an' can follow adjectives or nouns referring to border or adjacency.
Which preposition is used to address a person in a letter?

articles.text:
Prepositions – special uses of an
1. In referring to a location or destination on or by a body of water:
Letzten Sommer waren wir an der Ostsee.
Wenn ich es zeitlich schaffe, fahre ich noch an den Rhein.
Bremen liegt an der Weser.
Fahren Sie dieses Jahr an die Nordsee?
Last summer we were at the Baltic.
If I make it in time I'm going to drive to the Rhine.
Bremen is situated on the Weser.
Are you going to the North Sea this year?

2. To indicate the addressee or specific destination of a written communication:
Zuerst einen (Brief) an das Arbeitsamt und dann einen an die Handelskammer.
Schreiben Sie an die Botschaft.
Er schrieb einen langen Brief an den Generalkonsul.
Wo ist der Bericht an die Qualitz G.m.b.H.?
First a letter to the Employment Office and then one to the Chamber of Commerce.
Write to the Embassy.
He wrote a long letter to the Consul General.
Where is the report to the Qualitz Company?

3. In conjunction with particular adjective, verb or noun forms:
Meine Frau kann sich nicht an das Klima gewöhnen.
An dem Projekt waren zahlreiche ausländische Architekten beteiligt.
Der Tiergarten ist ein Park, der an den Zoo grenzt.
Sie erwähnten Ihr Interesse an der Geschichte der Insel.
My wife can't get used to the climate.
Numerous foreign architects participated in the project.
The 'Tiergarten' is a park that borders on the zoo.
You mentioned your interest in the history of the island.
